phrases.english_text: I worked at a few different places when I was a young man. I started working at Cookson Store for a while. George Stratton was the name of the owner. His wife's name was Helen, they were good people, very friendly. I worked there for a while and then that big water came and they closed it, then they started building on the water. Boat docks they called them, for boats, and then someone from Ft. Smith came and started building some like that there at Cookson Bend was the name there. He found out I was working, and he came to Cookson, “I will pay you more if you help me build those boat docks,” he told me. “We will see what happens, I help my friend out here,” I told him. “We will talk about it. I can't go with you right away. If I can give him a week or two weeks' notice that I am going to quit, then I will go,” I told him and he agreed so that is what I did and went to build where they put boats, boat docks. He had a little store, and I worked there and then I worked there for about two years and that store owner at Cookson, his son, a young man, he was building all the way around that lake you would call it. “Did you build those building at the lake?” he said. “Yeah, I helped,” I told him. “I am not building on the water I am building on the mountain,” he told me. “I want you to help me,” he said. “This really is my house where I walk and work,” I told him. “Don’t think anything. No mistake, I can meet here at the store and leave from here in the mornings. We will go around building. A meeting place will be at Cookson,” he said. “I will give him a week notice to find someone else to help him, I can't just quit,” I told him. So, I went and helped him for a week at a time, sometimes for longer. I was building around there on the water and then when we finished all those houses around the lake there is just a few buildings we did not build. And when we finished there, St. Claire Lime Company, Sallisaw then they called me and said you can help us. I have never made white dust before.“ You will not be making any, you can just watch the workers. If they are doing good or not, you will be sitting up high. There are stairs, you can sit up high on the second step, you can show them what to do,” he told me. “I don’t know if I can show them what to do, I have never done that before. I have never made lime before,” I told them. We are going to tell you what to do, you just have to watch the meters and when you watch the meters there were several of them and when you watch the meters, they got to hold at a certain degree. All 24 hours, they can't go up, they can't go down, they got to stay right there. “I can do that,” I told him. “I know you can do it,” that boss told me. Then I started there and worked for a long time. I was working there when I went into the Army, when I got out and finished the Army, where did I start then?

phrases.english_text: What? Oh yeah, I went back to the lake. Six-shooter was the name then I started there for a very long time, about 18 years. Then Cherokee Nation found out I was working there fishing; we had a fishing dock where people could go to fish. They found while they were there, the Chief, Ross Swimmer and someone named Bobby was with them. I was working there. They came, “We need your help,” they said. “You need my help? To catch a big fish, I'm going to have to take it out of the lake for you.” “No Charley, we bought Burnt Cabin, Burnt Cabin Marina, we want you to come over there and run it for us and fix it up. We need to fix it up really good, and you got this place fixed up good. We want that place fixed up that good.” “Well, I been working for this guy, helping this guy many years, about 18 years, I can't just walk off and quit.” “Think about it,” Ross Swimmer told me, “Think about it, we sure need help over there, we got people working over there rebuilding that place, but when they get off that dock it lays over.” It does! Yeah “what will make it do that?” he said. “They are not doing it right, that is why it is doing that. That’s why we need your help,” he told me there."You will be working for the Nation, Cherokees”, that is what I am. “Well, I will tell my boss what I am going to do, I got a boss here somewhere I will tell him, give him a notice, I can't just walk off and leave,” I told Ross. “Ok think about it,” he told me, when you make up your mind let us know.” OK, that was the end of that. Just the next morning he called back again, that one that was named Bobby was with Ross, came back. “Charley, have you thought about it?” “What do you think, what are you talking about?” “Helping us on that boat dock!” “I ain’t had time to think about it yet. I been doing some things I can't just stop and start thinking!” I told him. “Well think about it, you got to come help us,” Ross said when he came back the second time. Okay, I will be there about four or five days from now, got to let this guy know so he can have a replacement. When I went there, they really did have a broken-down building; we fixed it back up there. They had some workers from here they said were carpenters, but they did not know how to build on the water. They would be learning then. We started, but all the people were gone that had boats there. Because it was run-down, they did not want to stay in a run-down place. They were already gone, so I helped them. We fixed it up. I had been there about a month, and it was full where you put the boats. The buildings were standing good. I worked there for about a year. Ross and the one that was with him came and looked around to see what was going on. He said, “Charley, we sold this place.” “After all this hard work I went through fixing this place you already sold it!” I told him. Yeah, ok I barely got the keys out to use there. “Here are the keys,” I told him. “No, I can't do that, I got to let that guy come in first.You can show him around.” “Well, I ain’t got no job now since you sold this place.” “You just stay here till that guy comes.” “Ok,” I told them. He did come there in about two weeks. I gave him the keys, “Here is the keys. This key here fits that, and this fits that and that over there, and the cash register is right there. Here is the key to the cash register. I don’t know what they are going to do about that money, I don’t know whose money it is.” He got it, he made an agreement with Ross now. I didn’t have a job about two or three weeks; I still didn’t have a job.

phrases.english_text: What? Oh yeah, I went back to the lake. Six-shooter was the name then I started there for a very long time, about 18 years. Then Cherokee Nation found out I was working there fishing; we had a fishing dock where people could go to fish. They found while they were there, the Chief, Ross Swimmer and someone named Bobby was with them. I was working there. They came, “We need your help,” they said. “You need my help? To catch a big fish, I'm going to have to take it out of the lake for you.” “No Charley, we bought Burnt Cabin, Burnt Cabin Marina, we want you to come over there and run it for us and fix it up. We need to fix it up really good, and you got this place fixed up good. We want that place fixed up that good.” “Well, I been working for this guy, helping this guy many years, about 18 years, I can't just walk off and quit.” “Think about it,” Ross Swimmer told me, “Think about it, we sure need help over there, we got people working over there rebuilding that place, but when they get off that dock it lays over.” It does! Yeah “what will make it do that?” he said. “They are not doing it right, that is why it is doing that. That’s why we need your help,” he told me there."You will be working for the Nation, Cherokees”, that is what I am. “Well, I will tell my boss what I am going to do, I got a boss here somewhere I will tell him, give him a notice, I can't just walk off and leave,” I told Ross. “Ok think about it,” he told me, when you make up your mind let us know.” OK, that was the end of that. Just the next morning he called back again, that one that was named Bobby was with Ross, came back. “Charley, have you thought about it?” “What do you think, what are you talking about?” “Helping us on that boat dock!” “I ain’t had time to think about it yet. I been doing some things I can't just stop and start thinking!” I told him. “Well think about it, you got to come help us,” Ross said when he came back the second time. Okay, I will be there about four or five days from now, got to let this guy know so he can have a replacement. When I went there, they really did have a broken-down building; we fixed it back up there. They had some workers from here they said were carpenters, but they did not know how to build on the water. They would be learning then. We started, but all the people were gone that had boats there. Because it was run-down, they did not want to stay in a run-down place. They were already gone, so I helped them. We fixed it up. I had been there about a month, and it was full where you put the boats. The buildings were standing good. I worked there for about a year. Ross and the one that was with him came and looked around to see what was going on. He said, “Charley, we sold this place.” “After all this hard work I went through fixing this place you already sold it!” I told him. Yeah, ok I barely got the keys out to use there. “Here are the keys,” I told him. “No, I can't do that, I got to let that guy come in first.You can show him around.” “Well, I ain’t got no job now since you sold this place.” “You just stay here till that guy comes.” “Ok,” I told them. He did come there in about two weeks. I gave him the keys, “Here is the keys. This key here fits that, and this fits that and that over there, and the cash register is right there. Here is the key to the cash register. I don’t know what they are going to do about that money, I don’t know whose money it is.” He got it, he made an agreement with Ross now. I didn’t have a job about two or three weeks; I still didn’t have a job.

phrases.english_text: My grandmother was talking about, long time ago, someone was having family trouble. A man and a woman and the man’s mother. There was a dance somewhere where the natives dance and they went and the woman was running around on him. The old woman did not like her, that man's mother. The man did not want to let the woman go. “Don’t go! Let's just stay home,” he was saying. She didn’t obey; she went anyways. The old woman, the man's mother was saying, “Let her go,” she was telling him. So she went, his wife, she went to dance and then they just went to sleep, the man and his mother. The man laid down, he knew what his mother was going to do, that’s why he was forbidding his wife to go. She went and got some things that she was going to use, that old woman. What do they call fireplace?

When she came back, she had something sitting there, something fell in there, a piece of flint. The old lady had it laying there and it walked, I guess. The old woman said something to it, and it walked and when it came back, she told it “Now we did what we wanted to do” and she washed it off, that sanding tool. She told me I don’t know if it really happened, but that is what she used to tell me. They were mighty, grandmother used to say.

phrases.english_text: One time where I come from, to the west, he used to work like that. A man came but he had quit, he had become a preacher, making stuff like that. “Can you make me something? My wife left me, she left. Can you make me something for her to come back?” “’Do you have some smokes? I told him”, he said. “Yeah.” “Go in there and just sit down,” he said. “I will just smoke them smokes” he said. About five minutes later he came back in, “If you smoke this,” he said, “if she is going to come back, she is going to come back.” “I appreciate you!” he said. Then he left, he said. Two weeks later the man came back again. He said, “Can you make me something again?” “What is it?” the man told him. “She really is whiny… can you make me something for her to leave again?” he said. She was too whiny!
